run_bench_flat_l2_panorama: run the benchmark script to compare Flat vs FlatL2Panorama index QPS on SIFT1M or GIST1M datasets
run_bench_with_dataset_arg: run the benchmark with --dataset sift1m to benchmark Flat indexes on the SIFT1M dataset
eval_qps_function: eval_qps evaluates a FAISS index by measuring recall, queries per second, and ratio of dimensions scanned
build_index_function: build_index creates a FAISS index from a name string, trains it on training data, and adds database vectors
generate_benchmark_chart: generate a bar chart comparing QPS of Flat and FlatL2Panorama indexes and save it as a PNG file
